Participant.description: Anyone at the school: teacher, learner, parent or office staff. A first name alone is not an identity.

Group.description: A taught cohort, named by its course and level, independent of who is in it.

Membership.description:
Who belongs to a cohort and how: its teacher, an enrolled learner or a teaching assistant.
Assisting a cohort is not teaching it.

Buddy.description: A link between two people: speaking practice partners, or a substitute who covers someone's classes.

Lesson.description: One session for a cohort. booked_by arranged it, taught_by leads it, observer sits in without teaching.

Fee.description: Money owed for a cohort place. payer pays it, learner takes the place; they may differ.
